entries.15세 이상은 1회 24 mL씩, 11세 이상~15세 미만은 1회 16: Those 15 years and older take 24 mL at a time, those 11 years and older but under 15 years take 16 mL at a time, those 7 years and older but under 11 years take 12 mL at a time, those 3 years and older but under 7 years take 8 mL at a time, and those 2 years and older but under 3 years take 6 mL at a time, 4 times a day, after each meal and, if necessary, before bedtime. If needed, it may be taken about every 4 hours, up to 6 times a day.
entries.18세 이상 성인은 분사할 때 숨을 쉬지 말고 필요 시 3~6시간 마다: Adults 18 years and older should not breathe in while spraying and, when needed, spray 3 sprays into the throat at a time every 3 to 6 hours. Use it up to 5 times (15 sprays) a day at most; short-term use in the mouth only (up to 3 days) is recommended. Before using this medicine, point the spray nozzle away from your body and check that it sprays finely and evenly: at first use, prime it with at least 4 test sprays before use, and before every use prime it with at least 1 test spray.

Follow the specified dosage and administration carefully. When it is given to children, give it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. entries.가려움, 부종(부기), 통증, 시야변화, 지속적인 충혈이나 자극감을 경험: If you experience itching, swelling (puffiness), pain, changes in vision, or persistent redness or irritation; if symptoms worsen or persist for 72 hours or longer; if a person wearing hard contact lenses has heavy discharge such as eye mucus and, rarely, the lenses become clouded; or if this medicine is swallowed by mistake, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.갈락토오스 불내성, Lapp 유당분해효소 결핍증 또는 포도당-갈락토오스: Patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, infants under 3 months of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the specified dosage and administration carefully. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.경구용 당뇨병용제(톨부타미드), 콜레스티라민, 콜레스티폴, 약용탄, 마그: Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you take this medicine together with oral antidiabetic agents (tolbutamide), cholestyramine, colestipol, medicinal charcoal, antacids containing magnesium and aluminum hydroxide, medicines that reduce cholesterol in the bile (oral contraceptives containing estrogen) or medicines that reduce cholesterol in the blood (clofibrate), or medicines that damage the liver.
entries.경구투여 약물(항간질약 등), 알코올에는 잘 녹고, 물에는 상대적으로 용: Do not take this medicine together with orally administered medicines (such as antiepileptics) or with medicines that dissolve well in alcohol but have relatively low solubility in water. The polyethylene glycol 3350 contained in this medicine may increase their solubility.
entries.구강(입안)내 습기를 유지하는데 필요한 만큼 또는 의사의 지시에 따라 이: Spray this medicine directly into the mouth (oral cavity) or throat 1 to 2 times, as much as is needed to keep the mouth moist or as directed by a doctor.
entries.구역, 구토, 묽은 변 등이 나타나는 경우 이 약의 복용을 즉각 중지하고: If nausea, vomiting, or loose stools occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.구역, 구토, 묽은 변, 입안염, 식욕부진, 복부팽만감, 변비, 설사,: If nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomatitis (inflammation of the mouth), loss of appetite, abdominal bloating, constipation, diarrhea, erythema, urticaria, eczema, rash, maculopapular rash, itching, edema, or fluid retention (in patients with renal failure or heart failure) occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.구역, 구토, 설사, 묽은 변, 식욕부진, 복부팽만감, 변비, 저혈압,: If nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loose stools, loss of appetite, abdominal bloating, constipation, low blood pressure, facial flushing, irregular heartbeat, skin rash, red spots, asystole (cardiac arrest), depressed central nervous system function, gastrointestinal disorders, indigestion, upper abdominal pain, low blood pressure, pulmonary edema, erythema, urticaria, eczema, rash, maculopapular rash, itching, edema, or edema and fluid retention (in patients with renal failure or heart failure) occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.구역, 식욕부진, 복부(배부분)팽만감 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중: If nausea, loss of appetite, or abdominal (belly) bloating occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.근육병증(무력감, 사지경련, 마비 등)이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지: If myopathy (weakness, cramping of the limbs, paralysis, etc.) occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.급성질환에 성인은 1회 1캡슐(200 mg)씩, 1일 3회, 6~14세는: For acute conditions, adults take 1 capsule (200 mg) at a time, 3 times a day, and those aged 6 to 14 years take 1 capsule (200 mg) at a time, twice a day, before meals with a small amount of water. For chronic conditions, adults take 1 capsule (200 mg) at a time, twice a day, and those aged 6 to 14 years take 1/2 capsule (100 mg) at a time, 3 times a day, before meals with a small amount of water. For cystic fibrosis, those 6 years and older take 1 capsule (200 mg) at a time, 3 times a day, before meals with a small amount of water.
entries.눈 주위, 점막, 음부, 외음부, 습진, 습기참, 짓무름, 갈라짐 또는: Do not use it around the eyes, on mucous membranes, on the genitals or vulva, or on diseased areas with eczema, dampness, rawness, cracking, or severe wounds. Do not use it in infants 2 years of age or younger. Before using this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine or to cosmetics, people whose diseased area is on the face or is extensive, people whose diseased area is festering, people for whom the distinction between eczema and athlete's foot, tinea cruris, or tinea corporis is unclear, infants, and elderly people should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the specified dosage and administration carefully. When it is given to children, give it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only; do not take it internally. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse it out with water. Clean the diseased area and the surrounding skin before use. Do not use an occlusive dressing or wrapping unless directed by a doctor.
entries.눈의 충혈, 가려움, 부종(부기) 등이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하: If redness of the eye, itching, or swelling (puffiness) occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If a person wearing hard contact lenses has heavy discharge such as eye mucus and, rarely, the lenses become clouded, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.다른 비스테로이드성 소염진통제 및 나프록센 유도체, 아스피린, 고용량의: Do not take this medicine together with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics or naproxen derivatives, aspirin, or high-dose methotrexate. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you take it together with hydantoin antiepileptics, sulfonamides, sulfonylurea hypoglycemic agents, propranolol and other blockers, ACE inhibitors (such as captopril), loop diuretics and thiazide diuretics, probenecid, lithium, low-dose methotrexate, coumarin anticoagulants (blood-clotting inhibitors) (such as warfarin), zidovudine, or new quinolone antibiotics (such as enoxacin).

entries.두통, 감기, 호흡곤란, 미각이상, 구역, 구토, 설사, 상복부통, 복통: Headache, cold symptoms, difficulty breathing, taste disturbance, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, upper abdominal pain, abdominal pain, heartburn, urticaria, erythema, and eczema may occur.

entries.드물게 쇽(예: 구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란,: If hypersensitivity reactions occur — rarely shock (e.g., nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), occasionally rash or urticaria, and fatal anaphylactic shock of unknown frequency — stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Photosensitization may occur.
entries.드물게 쇽증상(흉부불쾌감, 오한, 호흡곤란, 혈압저하 등), 재생불량성빈: If the following occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist: rarely, shock symptoms (chest discomfort, chills, difficulty breathing, drop in blood pressure, etc.); blood disorders such as aplastic anemia, hemolytic anemia, granulocytopenia, thrombocytopenia, reduced platelet function (prolonged bleeding time), and eosinophilia; peptic ulcer, gastrointestinal bleeding, perforation, ulcerative colitis, bloody stools, gastritis, pancreatitis; Stevens-Johnson syndrome (mucocutaneous ocular syndrome) or toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome); triggering of asthma attacks, urticaria, eczema, purpura; occasionally rash, itching, and visual disturbances such as blurred vision and scotoma; aseptic meningitis (severe headache, nausea, vomiting, insomnia, stiff neck, fever, or impaired consciousness, etc.); acute renal failure, oliguria (decreased urination), hematuria, proteinuria, elevated BUN and blood creatinine, and hyperkalemia.
